test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Observe the dots on a dice (one to six dots) in the following figures. How many dots are contained on the face opposite to that containing four dots?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c9fdf85feff129b56d1c5e93cb1f8ad47f7eb0a2d06d5e00a4f80c153a49f5c.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'four dots', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0881b4ab7abc82e757589d4864d2c1cfff389c1b2e4f51b42f0bed1580c97316.png] 

From both dices, 5 and 3 dots are common. So, remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

So, **Six dots **will be opposite to four dots.

Hence, the correct answer is "Six".
